<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/story-tabs.ts -->
<!--
  A story in steps (years or slides). Axes: layout (years: a row of year tabs over the panel of the active year
  with its badge, step, title, text and tag; carousel: the heading beside a picture with previous and next
  arrows and one dot per step), tone. Choosing a step emits `select`.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { StoryLabels } from "./story-tabs.types";
  import type { Milestone } from "./milestone-timeline.types";

  export type StoryTabsProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    steps: Milestone[];
    active: string;
    labels: StoryLabels;
    layout?: "years" | "carousel";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    onselect?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import StoryDots from "../components/story-dots.svelte";
  import StoryPanel from "../components/story-panel.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    steps,
    active,
    labels,
    layout = "years",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    onselect,
  }: StoryTabsProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "years")}
  <SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} heading={{ badge }} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4" data-testid="story-tabs">
      {#each steps as s (s.id)}
        <Button
          variant={((s.id === active) ? "default" : "outline")}
          size="lg"
          type="button"
          class="h-auto flex-col items-start gap-0 py-2 text-start"
          data-testid="story-tab"
          data-active={((s.id === active) ? "true" : "false")}
          onclick={() => onselect?.(s.id)}
        >
          <Inline class="text-sm font-semibold">
            {s.date}
          </Inline>
          <Inline class="text-xs">
            {s.tag}
          </Inline>
        </Button>
      {/each}
    </Box>
    {#each steps as s, i (s.id)}
      {#if (s.id === active)}
        <StoryPanel s={s} index={i} total={(steps?.length ?? 0)} labels={labels} />
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true }}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    {#snippet aside()}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
        <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
        <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            type="button"
            aria-label={labels.previous}
            data-testid="story-arrow"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-left" size={16} />
          </Button>
          <StoryDots steps={steps} active={active} />
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            type="button"
            aria-label={labels.next}
            data-testid="story-arrow"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" size={16} />
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
